contract.task_clause:
Which of the following is a disadvantage of the random effects approach to estimating a panel model?
Option A: The approach may not be valid if the composite error term is correlated with one or more of the explanatory variables
Option B: The number of parameters to estimate may be large, resulting in a loss of degrees of freedom
Option C: The random effects approach can only capture cross-sectional heterogeneity and not temporal variation in the dependent variable.
Option D: All of (a) to (c) are potential disadvantages of the random effects approach.
